value.notes: MCE's own service-area page confirms Vallejo as one of 4 Solano County communities it serves (alongside Benicia, Fairfield, and unincorporated Solano County). PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service.

permit_authority.value: City of Vallejo Planning & Development Services, Building Division

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Vallejo/Solano County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

required_documents.notes: The page confirms Symbium-based SolarAPP+/SB 379 automated permitting exists, but a specific document checklist was not independently confirmed via direct fetch this session.

value: Schedule online inspection requests no later than 3:00 PM the evening prior to the requested inspection date, or via the Interactive Voice Response (IVR) system at (707) 648-4384
Inspections are scheduled first-come, first-served; the City recommends scheduling at least 3 business days in advance (no guarantee of next-day inspections)
Requests are assigned an AM (8am-12pm) or PM (12pm-4pm) 4-hour window; cancellations can be made up to 6:30am the day of the scheduled inspection
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building Division inspection scheduling process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

value.notes: The City's own Building Division page states 'Contractors and homeowners seeking to apply for residential solar or ESS permits under SB 379 will be able to apply for instantaneous permit issuance via this Symbium portal,' and separately advertises 'Apply now for an instant permit in Vallejo... Symbium has partnered with Vallejo to enable instant permits!' for Rooftop Solar or Battery Storage projects.

other_conditions: A solar permit does not include replacement or upgrading of the existing electrical panel or service — a separate electrical permit must be obtained
Equipment must be installed in accordance with its listing and the manufacturer's installation instructions

value.role: City of Vallejo Central Permit Center
